---
title: "Streaming Chatbot"
description: "Yield partial chat responses from a Python generator."
---

This coding playground streams an echo one character at a time. Click **Run**, send a message, and watch the generator update the response incrementally.

```{python}
import time
import gradio as gr

def slow_echo(message, history):
    for i in range(len(message)):
        time.sleep(0.05)
        yield "You typed: " + message[: i + 1]

demo = gr.ChatInterface(
    slow_echo,
    type="messages",
    flagging_mode="manual",
    flagging_options=["Like", "Spam", "Inappropriate", "Other"],
    save_history=True,
)

demo.launch()
```
